bib.title: Memory Augmented Neural Networks (Chapter 8, Fundamentals of Deep Learning)
bib.venue: book chapter (O'Reilly, Fundamentals of Deep Learning; year not printed in the chapter)

question: How can an RNN be given an external, differentiable working memory (NTM, then DNC) so it can learn algorithmic and reading-comprehension tasks?
contributions: Explains NTM attention-based read/write and content/location addressing
Explains DNC usage, allocation, freeing and temporal link mechanisms
Vectorised TensorFlow implementation tips and a bAbI DNC reproduction

results.claim: The reimplemented DNC reaches 15.78% mean error over the 20 bAbI tasks, against the original paper's mean 16.7±7.6%.
results.setup: DNC with LSTM controller, bAbI 20 tasks (10,000 train / 1,000 test questions each, jointly trained on 200,000), about 500,000 iterations, chapter author's TensorFlow reimplementation; error = % questions with any wrong answer word
results.table: Unnumbered report, row Mean Err., columns Result and Paper's Mean

limits: The bAbI reproduction is one run with no seeds or variance stated; learning rate, optimizer, batch size, memory size and controller size are not given in the chapter.
Fails badly on path finding (98.21% error) and induction/deduction.
Code uses TensorFlow 1.x APIs (tf.concat(1,..), TensorArray.pack/unpack, tf.while_loop) that have dated; transformers have since replaced memory-augmented RNNs for these uses.
Compares to the DNC paper mean over runs, not a matched protocol.
practices: Use a vectorised form (pairwise-add, cumulative product, sort + scatter) instead of Python for loops when building a TF graph (p.237-241).
Use tf.while_loop for the controller loop over time steps (p.241).
Weight the loss to 1 at answer steps and 0 elsewhere for bAbI (p.243).
Discard bAbI supervisory signals; lowercase, strip punctuation except ? and ., mask answer words with dashes, one-hot over 159 lexicon items (p.243).

terms.definition: a controller neural network (usually an RNN) with an external memory that resembles the brain's working memory
beta, attenuates content-based attention weights so near-uniform weights can be sharpened
scalar g_t in [0,1] mixing content-based weighting with previous weighting
size-N vector in [0,1], 0 completely free and 1 completely used location
memory location indices in ascending order of usage
intermediate weighting determining which memory location is allocated for new data
size-N vector in [0,1], 0 means a location can be freed, 1 retained
probability distribution over locations of which was last written to
N x N matrix, L[i,j] indicates how likely location i was written after location j
softmax over backward, lookup and forward emphasis per read head
whole architecture differentiable so gradient of output loss can be computed w.r.t. parameters
